stories.title: IA fuori controllo, Trump: “Non me ne preoccupo”. Bill Gates: “L’autoregolamentazione non basta”

en.title: AI out of control, Trump: "I'm not worried about it". Bill Gates: "Self-regulation is not enough"
en.summary: US President Trump met with Dario Amodei at the White House and expressed confidence regarding concerns raised by Anthropic and OpenAI about artificial intelligence safety.

stories.title: Mtv video music awards, Madonna apre lo show. Taylor Swift la più premiata della storia

en.title: MTV Video Music Awards, Madonna opens the show. Taylor Swift most awarded in history
en.summary: Taylor Swift received a record number of awards at the MTV Video Music Awards, where Madonna performed as the opening act and The Fate of Ophelia was named Video of the Year.

stories.title: Trionfo storico per Madonna e Taylor Swift, ai Nirvana il Video Vanguard Award

en.title: Historic triumph for Madonna and Taylor Swift, Nirvana receives Video Vanguard Award
en.summary: The 43rd MTV Video Music Awards crowned Madonna as Artist of the Year and honored Nirvana with the Video Vanguard Award, while Taylor Swift achieved a record number of wins.

stories.title: Trump, credo che vinceremo la guerra in Iran molto presto

en.title: Trump, I believe we will win the war in Iran very soon
en.summary: Trump expressed confidence about an imminent victory in a conflict with Iran, as new indirect talks between the United States and Iran were underway and Iran's Revolutionary Guards reported seizing a second American underwater drone near Hormuz.

stories.title: "L’IA sfugge al controllo? La sistemino". Trump sfida Pechino e snobba l'allarme falle

en.title: Does AI escape control? Trump dismisses concerns and challenges China
en.summary: The US President states that America is ahead of China in artificial intelligence and is investing billions of dollars in infrastructure development, expressing confidence rather than concern about AI safety issues.

stories.title: Trump, 'l'Ai che sfugge al controllo? Non me ne preoccupo'

en.title: Trump: 'AI that escapes control? I'm not worried'
en.summary: The US President asserts America's technological advantage over China and describes ongoing construction of massive infrastructure projects worth billions of dollars.

stories.title: Follia a un distributore di Reggio Emilia: tre feriti gravi, arrestato un 26enne

en.title: Violence at gas station in Reggio Emilia: three seriously injured, 26-year-old arrested
en.summary: A 26-year-old man attacked a 57-year-old woman with a screwdriver at a fuel station, then drove his vehicle into a man and a girl. The local mayor described the incident as a senseless act.

en.title: Trump: 'We will win this war very soon'
en.summary: US President Donald Trump expressed confidence in achieving rapid victory against Iran, mentioning expectations for oil-related developments following a successful outcome.

stories.title: Belgrado, il presidente Aleksandar Vucic si dimette per correre alle elezioni anticipate

en.title: Belgrade, President Aleksandar Vucic resigns to run in early elections
en.summary: Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic announced his resignation in a public speech, paving the way for early elections including a presidential race. Vucic aims to become prime minister since constitutional limits prevent him from seeking a third presidential term.

stories.title: Aggredisce donna e investe due persone a Reggio Emilia, arrestato

en.title: Assaults woman and hits two people in Reggio Emilia, arrested
en.summary: A violent incident occurred at a petrol station in the evening, resulting in three people being hospitalized with serious injuries. A man was arrested in connection with the attack.

stories.title: Il presidente serbo Vucic si dimette per candidarsi alle elezioni anticipate

en.title: Serbian President Vucic Resigns to Run in Early Elections
en.summary: Serbian President Vucic is stepping down from his position to run as a candidate for prime minister in early elections scheduled for October.

stories.title: Reggio Emilia, aggredisce una donna e investe due persone: arrestato

en.title: Reggio Emilia, man attacks woman and hits two people: arrested
en.summary: A man was arrested after assaulting a woman and striking two other people at a gas station in Reggio Emilia, leaving three people seriously injured.

stories.title: Benzina e diesel, anche Ip fisserà limiti ai prezzi

en.title: Petrol and diesel, Ip will also set price limits
en.summary: Socar is following Eni's example by implementing price caps on petrol and diesel across its Ip distribution network.

en.title: Work-life balance, certification underway
en.summary: A new certification process for companies implementing work-life balance policies under the Uni/Pdr 192:2026 standard is being launched.

stories.title: Halloween, è iniziato il conto alla rovescia per la notte dei fantasmi

en.title: Halloween, the countdown has begun for the night of ghosts
en.summary: Halloween-themed attractions featuring zombies, ghosts, skeletons, vampires, witches, monsters and pumpkins are populating theme parks during October as the All Saints' Day tradition gains prominence.

stories.title: «Regate in mezzo al publico come mai, Luna Rossa e New Zealand i team favoriti»

en.title: Races in the middle of the public like never before, Luna Rossa and New Zealand the favorite teams
en.summary: Francesco de Angelis describes the atmosphere in Naples and sailing conditions for preliminary races, with Luna Rossa and New Zealand positioned as competition favorites.

stories.title: Consolato americano a Milano, la società americana risarcisce i lavoratori con 30 milioni

en.title: American Consulate in Milan, American company compensates workers with 30 million
en.summary: Following a labor exploitation investigation by prosecutors, Caddell has reached a settlement agreement with a court-appointed administrator regarding worker compensation.
